description: The MT2000 Series combines the simplicity of a scanner with the intelligence of a mobile computer, provides advanced 1D/2D bar code, DPM and image capture, as well as the ability to key in and view data.802.11a/b/g, Bluetooth, corded and batch connectivity options provide the flexibility to meet a wide range of business needs.
